paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un gouluah dia gam hon piak a na va lut ua, na va ten chiang un;
heading: Pawltak Thillatte

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na gam leigah tung masapen chiat uh na hon tawi ding ua; bawm ah na koih ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un amin omsakna dia aseh ding ah na hoh ding uhi.
Huchi in siampu kiang ah na hoh ding ua, akiang ah, hon piak dia i pi-le-pute kiang a, achiamna gam ka hong tungta uh, chih tuni in TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah i hihlang uhi, na chi ding uh.
Siampu in na khut ua kipan bawm ala dia, TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam bul ah anga ding hi.
Nou TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, "Ka pu uh Siria mi, mivakvai ahi a, Aigupta gam ah apaisuk a, ava teng a, tawmchik ahi ua; huai ah nam thupitak, thilhihtheitak, tamtak ahong hita uhi.
Aigupta mite'n hon simmoh ua, hon hihgenthei ua, nasep haksa pipi hon semsak uh.
Huchi in TOUPA i pi-le-pute Pathian i sam ua, TOUPA'N i aw uh ana za a, i gentheihdan, i gimdan leh nuaisiah a i omdan amu hi.
TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan khut hattak, ban zak, thil lauhuaitak, chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte in ahon pikhia a;
hiai mun ah hon pilut a, hiai gam, nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ahon pia hi.
Ngai in, TOUPA aw, nang na hon piak leigah masapen chiatte ka hon tawi uhi,” na va chi ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na vual ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh bia in na kun ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na inkuante, noute, Levi mite, na lak ua gamdang mite thil hoih ahon piak tengteng ah kipaktak in na om ding uhi.

Kum thum kum, sawm-a-khat piak kum a na thil tung tengteng uh sawm-a-khat na piak khit uleh, Levi mite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite'n na omna uah ane ding uh, ahong khosak theih samna ding un.

TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, thu na hon piak tengteng bang in ka inn ua kipan thil siangthoute ka sepkhia ua, Levi mite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite ka peta uh. Na thupiak akoi mahmah ka bohse kei ua, ka mangngilh kei uhi.

Ka dah lai un huai ka ne kei ua, ka sian louh lai un ka thehthang sam kei ua, misi tuam a ding in leng ka pe sam kei uhi. TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw ka dawp ua, na hon thupiak tengteng bang in ka hih uhi.
Na omna siangthou van a pan hon en inla, nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, ka pi uh leh pute piak dia na kichiamsa bang in na mi Israelte leh na gam hon piak vualzawl in, na chi ding uh.
"Tuni in TOUPA na Pathian un hiai dan leh vaihawmte zui ding in thu ahon pia hi. Huaiziak in na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua pom in na zui ding uh ahi.
heading: Pathian Mite

paite: Tuni in TOUPA lampite zui a, adante, athupiakte leh avaihawmte zui a, a-aw dawp tum in na Pathian ding un na telta uh.
Thu ahon chiamsa bang in leh athupiak tengteng na zuihna ding un TOUPA'N tuni in amah a tuambik hi ding in noute ahon na telta hi.
Ana gensa bang a TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia a misiangthou na hihtheihna ding un leh nam a bawl tengteng tung a phat, minhoih leh pahtawi a na omtheihna ding un,” achi hi.
